articles.headline: Trump says deal to end Iran war will be signed Sunday, as Iran disagrees on timing
articles.summary: Pakistan's prime minister, a key mediator in U.S.-Iran talks to end the war, said Saturday that a peace deal was closer "than ever before," and could be finalized "in the next 24 hours."
articles._summary: Residents swim and play in the waters of the Strait of Hormuz while cargo ships and commercial vessels lie anchored in the distance off Bandar Abbas, Iran, Wednesday, June 10, 2026. Razieh Poudat/ISNA via AP hide caption Progress on a deal to end the Iran war appeared to mount on Saturday, with mediator Pakistan and the U.S. saying an agreement could be reached as soon as Sunday — although, Iran cast doubt on that timing. President Trump, who has asserted many times throughout the war that the countries are on the verge of an agreement, said Saturday morning on Truth Social that a deal was "scheduled to get signed" Sunday and that the Strait of Hormuz — a key global oil and gas transport route — would open soon after. Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei, however, said he didn't think a finalized pact would happen so soon.
articles._zh_headline: 特朗普称结束伊朗战争的协议将于周日签署，但伊朗在时间上存在分歧
articles._zh_summary: 2026 年 6 月 10 日星期三，居民们在霍尔木兹海峡的水域游泳和玩耍，而货船和商船则停泊在伊朗阿巴斯港远处。Razieh Poudat/ISNA，来自美联社 隐藏标题 周六，结束伊朗战争的协议似乎取得了进展，调解人巴基斯坦和美国表示最快可以在周日达成协议，不过伊朗对此时机表示怀疑。特朗普总统在整个战争期间多次声称两国即将达成协议，他周六早上在《真相社会》上表示，协议“计划于周日签署”，而霍尔木兹海峡——全球重要的石油和天然气运输路线——将在不久后开放。然而，伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴加伊表示，他认为最终协议不会这么快达成。

articles.headline: Micron Stock Has Become Volatile, But Key Metric Hints at Further Gains
articles.summary: Micron stock price has become highly volatile this month, but key valuation metrics suggest it has more gains to go.
articles._summary: Micron has become one of the best-performing companies in Wall Street. It has jumped by 232% this year, making it the second-best performing company in the S&P 500 Index after Sandisk (NASDAQ: SNDK ) . Micron has soared by over 1,100% in the last 12 months, with its market capitalization crossing the $1 trillion mark. Wall Street analysts are bullish on Micron, citing its large and growing addressable market and the ongoing DRAM shortage. Benzinga data shows that most pros have boosted their targets for the stock.
articles._zh_headline: 美光科技股价已变得不稳定，但关键指标暗示进一步上涨
articles._zh_summary: 美光已成为华尔街表现最好的公司之一。今年以来，该公司股价上涨了 232%，成为标准普尔 500 指数中表现第二好的公司，仅次于 Sandisk（纳斯达克股票代码：SNDK）。美光科技在过去 12 个月内飙升了 1,100% 以上，市值突破 1 万亿美元大关。华尔街分析师看好美光科技，理由是其庞大且不断增长的潜在市场以及持续的 DRAM 短缺。 Benzinga 数据显示，大多数专业人士都提高了对该股的目标。

articles.headline: Bitcoin Price Forms Risky Pattern as It Suffers $4.4 Billion Headwind
articles.summary: Bitcoin (CRYPTO: BTC) jumped above $64,250 on Saturday, helped by falling crude oil prices and dip buying among investors.
articles._summary: This week's outflows brought the monthly loss to over $2.4 billion. Added to the $2.4 billion they lost in May, these funds have lost 44.4 billion in the last two months, much higher than the $3.2 billion they added in March and April this year. Investors have likely moved to the stock market because of its stronger performance compared to crypto in the past two years. Also, investors have rotated from the "boring" Bitcoin to the booming AI and space ETFs ahead of key IPOs.

articles.headline: Co-Founders of a Company You've Probably Never Heard Of Just Added $100 Billion to Their Net Worth
articles.summary: The co-founders of Kingston Technology, David Sun and John Tu, have added $100 billion to their net worth this year amid the memory boom
articles._summary: John Tu , David Sun , and Kingston Technology, the company they founded in 1983, are not widely known names in the United States. Yet the ongoing artificial intelligence (AI) boom has made them some of the richest people in the world. Bloomberg data shows that the two have a similar net worth of $80.3 billion. Sun has added $49.3 billion, while Tu has added $49.2 billion to his wealth this year. They now rank as the 25th and 26th wealthiest people in the world.
articles._zh_headline: 一家你可能从未听说过的公司的联合创始人刚刚增加了 1000 亿美元的净资产
articles._zh_summary: John Tu、David Sun 和他们于 1983 年创立的金士顿科技公司在美国并不广为人知。然而，持续不断的人工智能（AI）热潮使他们成为世界上最富有的人之一。彭博社数据显示，两人的净资产相似，为 803 亿美元。今年，孙先生的财富增加了 493 亿美元，而涂先生的财富则增加了 492 亿美元。他们现在在全球最富有的人中排名第 25 位和第 26 位。
